ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90-95% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white pixels, with high-contrast low-intensity black pixels localized at the trailing edge and the point of insertion at the peduncle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary contiguous field of high-intensity white covering both lobes. A narrow, non-uniform band of black pigmentation follows the trailing edge. Micro-clusters of mid-intensity grey pixels (mottling) are distributed primarily along the vertical center and inner-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, symmetric V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65-75 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of ~1:4 within its immediate bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing boundary exhibits continuous, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 3 and 12 pixels, forming an irregular sawtooth-like profile against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges display a convex trajectory that curves posteriorly toward the distal tips; the trailing edge follows a complex sigmoidal curve from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 14 circular, high-contrast reddish-brown pixel clusters (diameters ranging from 5-20 pixels) scattered across the high-intensity white surface, with a higher density on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, grey, vertically oriented linear pixel disruptions (50-100 pixels in length) are mapped on the left lobe, breaking the contiguous white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced, irregular clusters of multi-toned (grey, white, and tan) protruding geometric masses at both distal tips; several reddish circular lesions are present on the mid-ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, irregular bulbous formations at the extreme lateral tips of the flukes, significantly altering the expected smooth biological curve of the leading edge termination.
